items.why: Cheaper black adjustable reading lamp, clean Scandinavian lines.
items.description: RANARP Floor/reading lamp - black. You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable. items.name: TRENSUM Mirror - stainless steel
items.why: Very cheap small stainless mirror, minimal and practical.
items.description: TRENSUM Mirror - stainless steel. One side with magnifying mirror. Suitable for use in high humidity areas since it is water-resistant. Tested and approved for bathroom use. Do not expose to direct sunlight. The sunbeams may reflect in the mirror glass and ignite flammable material.

palette: warm neutrals: cream, oatmeal and natural oak
notes: First picks total about $1,589, well under the $3,500 budget. Add sage throws and cushions for the accent colour, and hang the mirror above the dresser.
